note: What pi-arena pins for each bench Piglet. Until PiG 0.5.0 ships it pulls the Pigpen commit that contains the manifest (git rev-parse HEAD of the checkout it builds) and builds with the PiG source at pigRevision; after 0.5.0 it pulls the Piglet by its pi-in-go.dev version and `version` is filled in. pigRevision is the PiG commit the copied Go sources come from (bench/sync-spec.json) and the oldest PiG that builds the Piglet.
